title: Live-apply receipt — ADR 0420
description: Structured evidence that a Makefile converge-* target was successfully run and verified in production. Every receipt MUST include a non-empty 'verification' array with at least one passing check.

receipt_id.description: Unique receipt identifier. Matches the filename stem (without .json).

recorded_on.description: Date the receipt was written (YYYY-MM-DD). May differ from applied_on for backfills.

recorded_by.description: Who wrote the receipt (agent name, operator handle, or CI system).

source_commit.description: Full or abbreviated git commit SHA of the code that was live-applied.

repo_version_context.description: VERSION file value at time of live-apply.

workflow_id.description: Makefile target or workflow that was invoked (e.g. converge-harbor).

summary.description: Human-readable summary of what was deployed and why.

targets.description: Hosts, VMs, or services that were modified.

verification.description: Machine- or operator-observed checks confirming the deployment is healthy. At least one check is required; at least one must have result='pass'.

check.description: Short name for the check (e.g. 'Harbor registry ping').

observed.description: What was actually observed (HTTP 200, container running, etc.).

evidence_refs.description: Optional file paths or doc references providing additional evidence.

notes.description: Optional free-form notes (backfill context, known caveats, etc.).

examples.summary: Deployed harbor with json-file logging driver to prevent circular boot dependency.
